scope: Independent static review of the additive diagnostic-only source patch. No executable oracle was run by this review, no runtime is activated, and no latency or performance acceptance is established.
owner_baseline_decision: Exact same-compiler-input cached-versus-fresh raw request bytes; independent-stock verdict and diagnostic comparisons remain required. Earlier failed independent-stock byte comparisons remain recorded.
static_findings: The independent fresh owner is constructed from original typed pruned inputs before take_bucket can restore any prepared effects. Initial equality is mandatory.
Fresh and restored arms have separate NameCtxt, RefCells, graph capture, reporters, log-directory owners and bucket statistics; immutable current graph/order/span owners are shared.
ShadowScope suppresses primary event, obligation-ordinal and preparation-cache effects before state mutations. Shadow Verifiers are not merged into the primary.
Both arms create independent AIR and direct solver processes; solver choice is arm-local and does not mutate process-global environment.
The tee records actual accepted solver-input bytes, including original framing. Comparison preserves launch order and exact bytes without sorting or normalization.

Successful completion requires healthy complete capture, physical writer closure/join, successful solver termination, exact diagnostic emission classes/grouping, bucket outcomes, and postlowering/postverification effects.
Actual validated HIT is required before body/order/unused-effect faults are injected into the restored shadow. A MISS cannot establish a corruption-control pass.
review_feedback_addressed: Replace aliased Ctx cloning with independent Ctx::new and exact initial state checks.
Prevent shadow progress_start from mutating primary ORDINALS.
Collect fresh diagnostics directly to preserve grouped emission boundaries.
Capture physical writes and actual launch ordinals rather than transcript-log markers or Context creation order.
Require solver/writer completion and compare exact effects even when unused effects do not change solver bytes.
Bound combined raw, diagnostic and summary artifact output; shadow work is diagnostic overhead rather than preparation-cache memory or a performance claim.

pending_executable_requirements.positive: Actual validated prepared HIT, nonempty physical solver capture, exact same-input raw comparison, unchanged primary obligation identities/order, and equal stock verdicts/diagnostics.
pending_executable_requirements.negative: Postvalidated body/order/effect corruption reaches an actual HIT and fails the appropriate raw-byte or exact-effect comparison.
pending_executable_requirements.evidence_capture: Code review confirmed per-case assertions_completed and final all_controls_completed flags saved after checks, plus drained stdout/stderr/deadline metadata on timeout. Executable behavior still awaits runtime qualification.
pending_executable_requirements.scope: Executable tests and full actual-workload qualification remain separate from this static review.

reported_component_tests.source: Implementation agent reported these passes; this reviewer did not execute them.

performance_scope: Two independent shadow proofs, logs and working state are diagnostic overhead. Their wall time and RSS cannot establish M7 speedup or reader latency.
